description: The file defines the ConceptSource class in the OpenMRS core, representing a source of medical concepts such as ICD9, ICD10, SNOMED, etc. It includes fields for concept source ID, HL7 code, and a unique identifier, along with associated getters and setters.

classes.name: ConceptSource
classes.description: Represents a source of medical concepts, including identifiers and codes used in medical terminology systems.

methods.name: getConceptSourceId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the ConceptSource.

methods.name: setConceptSourceId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the ConceptSource.

methods.name: getHl7Code
methods.description: Returns the HL7 code associated with this ConceptSource.

methods.name: setHl7Code
methods.description: Sets the HL7 code for this ConceptSource.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier string for this ConceptSource.

methods.name: setUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier string for this ConceptSource.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this ConceptSource, overrides method from OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID for this ConceptSource, overrides method from OpenmrsObject.
